raw: It’s new to me, but you are right, I dare say.”
Stryver, I claim to characterise for myself--And understand me, sir,” said Mr.
Lorry, quickly flushing again, “I will not--not even at Tellson’s--have it characterised for me by any gentleman breathing.”
I beg your pardon!” said Stryver.

Stryver, I was about to say:--it might be painful to you to find yourself mistaken, it might be painful to Doctor Manette to have the task of being explicit with you, it might be very painful to Miss Manette to have the task of being explicit with you.
